about_short_description.short_description: CodeCrafters is a software company that offers coding and software porfessionals a platform to practice writing complex code.

product.name: CodeCrafters Programming Challenges
product.description: A platform offering advanced programming challenges where users build complex software projects from scratch to deepen their coding skills.

product.name: Solutions Feature
product.description: A feature providing recommended solutions and explanations for stages within programming challenges to help users validate or explore alternate approaches.

product.name: Publish to GitHub Integration
product.description: A tool that allows users to publish their CodeCrafters project code directly to GitHub repositories for showcasing and accountability.

product.name: Membership Plans
product.description: Subscription plans providing access to the full catalog of programming challenges, instant feedback, code examples, and additional platform features.

product.name: Challenge Extensions Voting
product.description: A community-driven feature allowing users to vote on proposed extensions to existing programming challenges to deepen or broaden the scope of projects.
